ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِنَّ مِنكُمْ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنْ أَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُن مَّعَهُمْ شَهِيدًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَإِنَّ مِنكُمْ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنْ أَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُن مَّعَهُمْ شَهِيدًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form II) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ is in the derivative form: يُبَطِّئُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ط/أ   b–ṭ–ʾ this root denotes the single concept of slowness, of which only يُبَطِّئُ yubaṭṭiʾ occurs 11 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يُبَطِّئُ yubaṭṭiʾ [imperf. of v. II بَطَّأَ baṭṭaʾa, intrans./trans.] to hold back, to lag behind, also to cause someone to lag behind or hold back

(4:72) مِنْكُمْ لَمَنْ لَيُبَطِّئَنَّ وَإِنَّ and among you are the ones who lag behind [also interpreted as: who urge others to lag behind].
